material.description: Browser page probes (map, reconnect, self-reload, rejected edit) fail: the moba input probe finds no unit it can left-click, all units report hidden at 1024x768. Fails on c4d3f23 and f64965e, so it predates the shadow change. Likely cause: the lobby overlay (008f08f) or the HUD bar (69be973) covers the map at that size. Reproduce at that sha, fix the overlay or the probe's camera step in the owning file group, witness with ci-status.
material.subject: CI moba probe finds no clickable unit at 1024x768
material.witness: CI run 39457149210 green on 925b8b4: the moba probe found clickable units and its match, input and attack-move checks passed.
